name: Selected Texts in Indian Philosophy
description: This course offers a critical engagement with a classical Indian philosophical text along with its commentaries. The course emphasizes debates and arguments between the proponent and the opponent in a particular classical Indian philosophical text. Students will learn how to revisit a classical philosophical text in contemporary philosophical discussion.
